svg.title: Order your Dockerfile so the layer cache does its job (and the whitespace edit that busts it anyway)
svg.desc: A vertical stack of Docker image layers split at a thick accent break line — the upper two layers (manifest copy and npm install) carry cool-filled cache-hit checkmarks, the lower two (source copy and build step) carry warm-filled cache-miss crosses — with an edit-file arrow entering from the right into the source layer and a cascade arrow descending the left structural rail. Trace Bloom generative banner for “Order your Dockerfile so the layer cache does its job (and the whitespace edit that busts it anyway)”. A manhattan lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 1991444518.
